title: Vielezi (Theme 7: Huduma katika asasi za kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses adverbs of place (hapa, kule, humu, nyumbani) by distance and inside or outside, and adverbs of number (mara mbili, mara kwa mara).
contexts: social services: alitembelea zahanati mara tatu

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "humu" and one sentence with "mara mbili".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kielezi kipi cha mahali?" Kwa nini "mara mbili" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kielezi kipi cha idadi?" Kwa nini "huku" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mara mbili ni kielezi cha idadi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kielezi cha mahali hujibu swali gani?" Kwa nini "Lini?" si jibu sahihi?
